description: Conservation of the ASNSD1 C-terminal class I PDZ-binding motif across vertebrate orthologs, with a figure summarising the motif and the PDZ content of the recorded partners.
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter

orth = pd.read_csv("asnsd1_vertebrate_orthologs.csv")
print("columns:", list(orth.columns))
seqcol = [c for c in orth.columns if orth[c].astype(str).str.match(r'^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]{100,}$').mean() > 0.5][0]
print("sequence column:", seqcol)

s = orth[seqcol].dropna().astype(str)
s = s[(s.str.len() > 550) & (s.str.len() < 750)]
last4 = s.str[-4:]
cls1 = last4.str.match(r'^.[ST].[VILFYMA]$')
print(f"\nfull-length-like vertebrate ASNSD1 orthologs scored: {len(s)}")
print(f"C-terminus matching class I PDZ-binding motif [ST]-x-phi at (-2,-1,0): {cls1.sum()}/{len(s)} ({100*cls1.mean():.1f}%)")
print("most common C-terminal tetrapeptides:", dict(Counter(last4).most_common(8)))
print("residue at the C-terminal position (0):", dict(Counter(s.str[-1]).most_common(5)))
print("residue at position -2                :", dict(Counter(s.str[-3]).most_common(5)))
print("\nhuman ASNSD1 ends LENLSIEKETKL; human ASNS ends RTLTHYKSAVKA (no class I motif)")

pdz = pd.read_csv("asnsd1_interaction_partners.csv").sort_values("n_PDZ", ascending=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.6))
top = Counter(last4).most_common(10)
ax[0].barh([t for t, _ in top][::-1], [c for _, c in top][::-1], color="#1f7a5a")
ax[0].set_xlabel("number of vertebrate ASNSD1 orthologs")
ax[0].set_title(f"ASNSD1 C-terminal tetrapeptide\nclass I PDZ motif in {100*cls1.mean():.0f}% of {len(s)} orthologs")
ax[1].barh(pdz.gene[::-1], pdz.n_PDZ[::-1], color="#7a1f4f")
ax[1].set_xlabel("PDZ domains in the partner protein")
ax[1].set_title("All 22 recorded ASNSD1 partners are PDZ proteins\n98 PDZ domains in total")
ax[1].tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=7)
for a in ax: a.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

pd.DataFrame({"last4": last4.value_counts()}).to_csv("asnsd1_cterm_motif.csv")
print("wrote asnsd1_cterm_motif.csv")
